title: Completeness comparison of equivalence fibers with object paths
statement:
Use simplicial sets, Kan complexes, internal functor simplicial sets, homotopy fibers and weak homotopy equivalences from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], Kan fibrations from [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper], and complete Segal spaces from [def-coef-segal-space]. Let $W$ be a complete Segal space, put $A=W_0$ and $p_W=(d_1,d_0):W_{\mathrm{eq}}\to A^2$. For vertices $x,y$ of $A$, let $E_W(x,y)$ be the union of the isomorphism components in the strict mapping fiber $M_W(x,y)$, using the homotopy category of [lem-coef-segal-homotopy-category-components]. Put $K_A=\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,A)$, $q_A=(\operatorname{ev}_0,\operatorname{ev}_1):K_A\to A^2$, and let $c_A:A\to K_A$ insert constant paths. Write $\Delta_A:A\to A^2$ for the diagonal and $\operatorname{Path}_A(x,y)=\operatorname{fib}_{(x,y)}q_A$.

There is a zigzag of weak homotopy equivalences
$$E_W(x,y)\longrightarrow\operatorname{hofib}_{(x,y)}p_W\longleftarrow\operatorname{hofib}_{(x,y)}\Delta_A\longrightarrow\operatorname{hofib}_{(x,y)}q_A\longleftarrow\operatorname{Path}_A(x,y).$$
The outer arrows insert constant base paths; the inner arrows are induced on the specified path-model homotopy fibers by $s_0:A\to W_{\mathrm{eq}}$ and $c_A$, respectively, over $A^2$. For every map $f:W\to W'$ of complete Segal spaces, the maps $f_0,f_1$, and postcomposition by $f_0$ on paths induce a commuting map of these zigzags at $(x,y)$ and $(f_0x,f_0y)$, retaining every simplex. For $x=y$ each arrow preserves the points represented by the identity arrow, the vertex $x$ with its constant base path, and the constant loop $c_A(x)$, as applicable. No nonemptiness of off-diagonal fibers is assumed.
